data.one_liner: A port of the Java Topology Suite for spatial data processing in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides geometry types, spatial predicates, buffers, distance operations, spatial indexing, and geometry readers/writers. It allows mobile, desktop, and web applications to perform computational geometry operations.
use_when: You need to perform spatial analysis or geometry operations in a Dart application.
You are working with geographic data formats like WKB or Spatialite geometries.
You need spatial indexing like quadtrees in Dart.
avoid_when: You only need simple map rendering and visualization without spatial analysis.
You require high-level map widgets rather than raw geometry processing utilities.
strengths: Comprehensive port of the Java Topology Suite (JTS).
Supports all geometry types, predicates, buffers, and distance operations.
Works across mobile, desktop, and web environments.
weaknesses: Limited documentation specific to Dart beyond the original Java concepts.
Niche use case outside of GIS-heavy applications.
data.setup_notes: Add dart_jts to pubspec.yaml and import it.
